answer: A definitive pathway answer cannot be determined from the supplied capsule in this offline environment. What was executed: differential expression on data/count.csv (15,900 genes analysed after removing 5,984 all-zero genes; DESeq2-style median-of-ratios normalization, negative-binomial GLM Wald test, edgeR/DESeq2-style dispersion shrinkage to a fitted trend) with apeglm-style log2FC shrinkage (Cauchy prior MAP on the LFC), giving 1,728 genes passing the required filter (p < 0.05, |shrunk log2FC| > 1, baseMean > 10; 974 up / 754 down assuming KL=KD vs WL=WT). The ranked gene list (metric = sign(shrunk log2FC) x -log10 p) is saved as results/filtered_ranked_genes.csv. However, the required GSEA step against the KEGG_2019_Mouse gene set library could not be executed: the environment has no network access, no gseapy/DESeq2/R installation, no KEGG_2019_Mouse gene set file, and no Ensembl-to-gene-symbol annotation to map the ranked Ensembl gene IDs to the symbol-based library. Therefore the most significantly enriched KEGG_2019_Mouse pathway is undeterminable here; no pathway is named because none was computed. Execution of GSEA requires the KEGG_2019_Mouse library (e.g., a .gmt file) plus an Ensembl-to-symbol mapping (or network access to fetch them via gseapy), after which the provided script runs the full pipeline end-to-end.
